facts.statement: Primapus lived during the Early Eocene epoch.
Primapus fossils were discovered in the London Clay, a formation deposited approximately 50 million years ago.
facts.quote: Its fossils were found in the London Clay, which was deposited around 50 million years ago.

facts.statement: The genus Primapus existed between 56 and 48.07 million years ago during the Ypresian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Ypresian to Ypresian (56 to 48.07 million years ago)

facts.statement: Primapus is classified as an extinct genus of birds belonging to the Apodiformes order.
facts.quote: Primapus is an extinct genus of apodiform bird

facts.statement: The type species of the genus Primapus is P. lacki.
facts.quote: The type species is P. lacki.

facts.statement: Fossils of Primapus have been found in the United Kingdom.
facts.quote: Primapus is an extinct genus of apodiform bird from the Early Eocene of the United Kingdom.
